$comment: Shared agent-eval registry. Each key is a pipeline agent; the value declares WHERE its gold eval set lives, HOW to score it (label | artifact), which field of a row feeds the agent, and the pass threshold used as a CI gate. LABEL mode invokes the agent headless with tools disabled and exact-matches routing booleans. ARTIFACT mode copies the product-truth store into a throwaway /tmp sandbox, invokes the WRITE-capable agent there (cwd=sandbox, LEAFCUTTER_REPO_ROOT=sandbox, so all writes stay contained), then scores the produced *.mock.json / *.flow.json with the deterministic assertions of TQ-200a-2-ii (schema-valid, entities-in-registry, extend-not-duplicate, referenced-records-exist, one acceptance_scenario per step/branch, id path-stable) plus an optional per-row LLM-judge rubric. All paths are relative to the repo root.

pt-classifier.notes: Booleans are the scored labels; outcome is derived from them via OUTCOME_BY_COMBO and reported as a secondary accuracy figure. Model pinned to haiku to match the pt-classifier template frontmatter. response_label_field names the sub-object of the model's returned JSON that holds the axes (pt-classifier's S4 contract nests them under 'expected'); omit or null it when an agent returns the axes at top level.

mock-data-author.notes: Runs in a per-row /tmp sandbox copy of docs/product-truth. Deterministic assertions are the gate; the key check unique to this agent is extend-not-duplicate (single_canonical_dataset) — the validator does NOT enforce it. validator_clean is a DELTA gate (the agent must introduce no NEW validator errors vs the reconciled baseline), robust to a store a concurrent session is mid-editing. Model=opus per the template frontmatter. Threshold 0.66 = >=2/3 rows as the CI gate; 3/3 is the fully-wired bar.

flow-author.notes: Per-row /tmp sandbox copy of docs/product-truth. The GOLDEN row removes the gold track-an-order artifact (sandbox_prep.remove_artifacts) so the agent must reverse-engineer it. Assertions cover ordered steps, screens-resolve, one acceptance_scenario per step AND per branch, has_branch (the held-out journey requires an alternate path), and extend-not-duplicate for the negative add-vs-create row. validator_clean is a DELTA gate. Model=opus per the template frontmatter.
